# Conformance cases whose self-host x86-64 run disagrees with their sidecars
# (expected.stdout, expected.exit), which the oracle, internal/oracle/interp,
# satisfies. Read by TestFernFixturesSelfHostX86_64 and TestFernFixturesSelfHostX86_64Quarantine.
#
# Format: <case-name> <#issue> <reason>
#
# A listed case must still diverge and a case not listed must pass, so the
# list can only shrink. It is empty: a divergence is a bug to fix, and a row
# is for one whose fix is in flight, with the measured self-host and oracle
# values in its reason.
